resources.string: Gestures and touch
Keyboards and braille
Voice commands and text editing
Commands and settings
Sound, speech and recognition
Gesture trainer

The gesture trainer measures your gestures against the limits that SandFly uses, and names the settings to change. Go to Settings, Help & feedback, Gesture trainer, choose a group, and make each gesture 3 times. It needs Android 13 or later.
Triple-tap and Quadruple-tap
One-finger taps anywhere on the screen. Go to Settings, Gestures, 1 finger. They have no command by default and need Android 13 or later.
Hold a touch on the focused item

This command holds a touch on the focused item for as long as you hold the keys, for buttons such as the voice message button in Telegram. Press and release the keys quickly to keep the touch down until you press them again. The command is in Settings, Commands, Activation.
BlackBerry mode
Gestures, keys and sounds similar to those of the BlackBerry 10 Screen Reader. Go to Settings, Settings profiles, BlackBerry mode, or use the Turn BlackBerry mode on or off command.
Keyboard practice

SandFly says each key you press and the command it runs, without running it. Go to Settings, Help & feedback, Keyboard practice, or press SandFly key + K in the VoiceOver keymap. Press the keys again, Back or Escape to stop.
Auto-correct and Word suggestions

The SandFly keyboard can correct misspelled words and list suggestions for the word you type. Up Arrow and Down Arrow move through the suggestions, and Enter types one. Go to Settings, Typing, Physical keyboard. Both are off by default.
Speak password characters

With the SandFly keyboard, SandFly says the characters typed in a password field. Go to Settings, Typing, Physical keyboard, Speak password characters. The Spell the password field command, in Settings, Commands, Text editing, spells the text of the field.
Send key
On a keyboard phone, the Send key presses the Send button in messaging apps.
Fast search and browse mode

In browse mode, the Fast search key with a letter moves to the next item that starts with that letter. Go to Settings, Keyboard shortcuts, Fast search. The Keyboard phone single-key keymap has browse mode: press the SandFly key twice.
Braille

New braille tables: Indonesian and Unicode Braille. Go to Settings, Braille, Braille keyboard, Languages, Add a language. Keep the keyboard open after sending and Return to the previous keyboard are in Settings, Braille, Braille keyboard.
Start voice editing

This command records voice commands for the focused text field one after another, such as \"select all\", \"copy\", or \"type\" and a text. Say \"stop editing\" to end. The command is in Settings, Commands, Text editing.
Voice commands for text

Move the cursor, select, copy, cut and delete by characters, words, sentences, lines or paragraphs, such as \"delete next five words\" or \"end of line\". The phrases are in the user guide, Appendix C.
New line, Next sentence and Previous sentence
New line types a new line, or performs the action of a field of one line. Next sentence and Previous sentence are in Settings, Commands, Navigate by text.
Mute key
On phones with a mute key, such as the Zinwa Q25, hold the mute key in a text field to dictate. Go to Settings, Volume keys.
Answer call and End call
Both commands also act on calls of apps such as WhatsApp. End call declines or ends a call. The commands are in Settings, Commands, System actions.
App tiles and System tiles
Command categories that activate quick settings tiles. Go to Settings, Commands.
Search commands
The search field at the top of Settings, Commands lists the commands that match the words you type. The screen of each command has Perform gesture, Run command and Add to SandFly menu.
Help
Help, in the app bar of settings screens, opens the section of the user guide about the screen.
Script code
On the page of a script, View code shows the code and Edit code changes it. To install a script from code, go to Settings, Scripts, New script from code.
AI service reading control
Swipe up or down to switch between the AI services that are set up. Add it in Settings, Reading controls.
Actions available
A sound plays for items with extra actions, such as Reply on a chat message. Go to Settings, Sound and vibration, Actions available sound.
Sound themes

To replace a sound, Choose from folder lists the sound files of a folder and plays the focused file. 3D audio has the choice With headphones, centred otherwise. Go to Settings, Sound and vibration, Sound themes.
Speech rate step and Play sample
Speech rate step sets how much the speech rate changes at a time. Go to Settings, Speech, Speech rate step. Each voice profile has Play sample.
Speak during media playback
Speaks the screen-off and unlock announcements while media plays. Go to Settings, Verbosity, Screen on and off.
Color detection and Light level tone
Live recognition names the colors in the centre of the camera view, or plays a tone whose pitch rises with the brightness. Go to Settings, Image and screen descriptions, Live recognition.
Cyrillic text recognition
Text recognition reads Russian, Ukrainian and other languages written in Cyrillic, with a model that you download. Go to Settings, Image and screen descriptions, Cyrillic text recognition.
